hero.subheadline: Gamasome's AI platform transforms raw data from cameras, sensors, and devices into intelligent, real-time decisions. From computer vision to spatial AI, we power the next generation of autonomous systems.

capabilities.title: Computer Vision
capabilities.description: Train and deploy visual AI models that detect, track, and understand objects in real-time video and image streams with sub-100ms latency.

capabilities.title: Spatial AI & 3D Modeling
capabilities.description: Convert real-world environments into digital 3D models using our G-Space platform — just a smartphone camera, no LiDAR required.

capabilities.title: Natural Language Processing
capabilities.description: Build multilingual AI interfaces that understand context, sentiment, and intent from unstructured text and voice data at scale.

capabilities.title: Predictive Analytics
capabilities.description: Uncover patterns and forecast business outcomes with ML-powered prediction pipelines trained on your domain-specific data.

useCases.title: Smart Inventory & Shelf Intelligence
useCases.description: AI-powered computer vision monitors shelf stock levels in real time, detects misplacements, and triggers automated restocking alerts.

useCases.title: Medical Imaging Analysis
useCases.description: Deep learning models assist radiologists by analysing X-rays, MRIs, and CT scans with clinical-grade accuracy and speed.

useCases.title: Automated Quality Control
useCases.description: Visual inspection systems detect micro-defects on production lines at speeds and precision no human inspector can match.

useCases.title: Traffic & Surveillance AI
useCases.description: Real-time object detection and crowd analytics for traffic optimisation, safety monitoring, and urban intelligence platforms.

useCases.title: Autonomous Vehicle Perception
useCases.description: Multi-sensor fusion and object detection pipelines that give autonomous vehicles the spatial awareness to navigate safely.

useCases.title: AI-Powered 3D Avatars
useCases.description: Create lifelike digital humans and immersive environments for metaverse, gaming, and extended reality experiences.

howItWorks.title: Collect & Annotate
howItWorks.description: Gather data from cameras, sensors, and IoT devices. Our platform structures and annotates it for AI training with precision labelling tools.

howItWorks.title: Train & Validate
howItWorks.description: Train custom models on your domain-specific data. Iterate with automated testing pipelines until performance targets are met.

howItWorks.title: Deploy & Monitor
howItWorks.description: Deploy models to edge devices, cloud APIs, or embedded systems. Monitor performance in production with real-time dashboards.
